'''Thermal charges''' were a type of [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charge]]. Rebels operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]], including [[Mora]],<ref name="EGTPM" /> [[Merrik]],<ref name="RoC4">''[[River of Chaos 4]]''</ref> and [[Ranulf Trommer/Legends|Ranulf Trommer]], used thermal charges to destroy [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Grigor (governor)|Grigor's]] secret [[dragite crystal]] [[Mining/Legends|mine]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
